rules.title: Ronald V. Dellums Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance
rules.requirement: Rental housing providers may not ask about or use criminal history or criminal background checks in advertising, applications, tenant selection or other decisions. Prohibited acts include: inquiring about criminal history; indicating that persons with criminal backgrounds will not be considered; refusing to rent or terminating a tenancy based on criminal history; requiring disclosure or authorization for release of criminal history; demanding a higher security deposit or rent based on criminal history; refusing to add an immediate family member based on their criminal history; and disqualifying tenants from rental assistance programs such as Section 8 based on criminal history. If a landlord takes any action against an applicant or tenant based on criminal history, the landlord must give written notice and an opportunity to respond.
rules.key_value: Administrative fines of $1,000 to $10,000 per violation; civil damages of actual damages or 3x one month's rent; punitive damages; attorneys' fees and costs; injunctive relief

unverifiable_exemptions: Units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back to their home in accordance with BMC 13.76.130 A.9
Units occupied by existing tenant(s) seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates
coverage.summary: Applies to rental housing providers in Berkeley, with exemptions for owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units, lifetime sex offenders, limited public housing/Section 8 properties, owner move-back units, and sublets or roommate changes.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied properties (between 1-3 units) in which an owner of record resides in one of the units as their primary residence are exempt.

rules.exemptions: Lifetime sex offenders; public housing/Section 8 properties (limited exemptions); owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units where an owner of record resides in one unit as their primary residence; units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back under BMC 13.76.130 A.9; units occupied by existing tenant(s) seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates.
rules.effective_date_note: The passages give only the City Council passage date of April 14, 2020 and no effective date.

rules.quoted_span: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.
rules.review_note: Based on the Rent Board overview page, not the ordinance text. The exemptions are summarized and the page says to view the Ordinance for each exemption's requirements.
rules.source_notes: Official Berkeley Rent Board page (D003). The other passages in this set (NJ statute, a non-Berkeley policy, and California source-of-income law) are not Berkeley ordinances and were not extracted.
